fallback: A return cycle is not a cosmic rerun. It is a familiar door opening under new conditions. Something in your life is circling back so you can meet it with more context, better instincts, and a clearer sense of what the moment is actually asking from you. Look for the theme that feels recognizable but not identical; that is where the next layer of the story begins.
solar_return: This is your yearly authorship point: the moment your core direction asks for a fresh draft. The focus is not becoming a brand-new person, but noticing which version of you has enough heat, coherence, and appetite to lead the next chapter. Pay attention to what restores your vitality, what drains your signal, and where life is quietly asking you to stop performing an outdated role.
lunar_return: This return brings your inner weather to the foreground. Your needs, habits, attachments, and private rhythms become easier to hear, especially the ones you usually override in order to stay functional. The useful question is simple and intimate: what kind of care would let your nervous system tell the truth without having to make a crisis out of it?
jupiter_return: This is a major expansion threshold, where your relationship to faith, opportunity, teaching, travel, risk, generosity, and scale begins a new twelve-year arc. The invitation is not to say yes to everything that opens, but to recognize which opening makes your world larger in a way your future self can inhabit. Notice the doors that arrive through trust, learning, mentorship, and courageous participation.
saturn_return: This is a maturation threshold: the place where borrowed definitions of adulthood stop being enough. Life asks what you are willing to build slowly, maintain honestly, and take responsibility for without abandoning yourself in the process. The gift is not pressure for pressure's sake; it is the chance to become someone whose choices have structure, weight, and real continuity.
